title: The `-knowledge-refresh` suffix is documented only as a recognition rule for an existing phase, never as a naming mandate for a newly-created one, so the deterministic recursion-guard silently does not apply to a plausible, convention-conformant phase name that omits the exact suffix
No test exercises a non-string phase list entry mixed with a `-knowledge-refresh`-suffixed entry, leaving the new check's `all(isinstance(phase, str) ...)` guard-and-skip path unverified
